level.title: Level 1: Starter Communication Foundations
level.description: Fondasi terpenting bahasa Inggris praktis: identitas diri, kata ganti, kepemilikan, dan pola rutinitas harian tanpa ragu.

modules.title: Personal Pronouns & Self Identity
modules.objective: Menguasai kata ganti orang (I, You, He, She, It, We, They) dan menyatakan identitas tanpa tertukar.

content.summary: Subject Pronoun adalah kata pengganti orang atau benda yang melakukan tindakan atau menjadi subjek kalimat.

rules.example: I live in Jakarta.
You are my friend.
He is my brother.
She is a doctor.
It is a new phone.
We learn English together.
They are in the office.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan Fatal Orang Indonesia: Menggunakan 'Me' di Posisi Subjek
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula mengatakan 'Me and my friend go to school'. Dalam bahasa Inggris baku, posisi subjek WAJIB menggunakan 'I'.
commonTrap.wrong: Me like coffee. / Me want to sleep.
commonTrap.correct: I like coffee. / I want to sleep.

content.context: Sarah bertemu Reza di ruang orientasi belajar bahasa Inggris.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Hello! I am Sarah. Are you a new student here?

lines.speaker: Reza
lines.text: Hi Sarah! Yes, I am. My name is Reza. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Nice to meet you too. Who is that girl over there?

lines.speaker: Reza
lines.text: Oh, she is my sister. Her name is Dinda. We study here together.

drills.hint: Ucapkan 'Syi', jangan 'Si'.
Tegaskan subjek 'We' dan lidah di gigi untuk /ð/.

roleplay.context: Sarah bertemu Reza di ruang orientasi belajar bahasa Inggris.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Hello! I am Sarah. Are you a new student here?

turns.speaker: Reza
turns.text: Hi Sarah! Yes, I am. My name is Reza. Nice to meet you.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Nice to meet you too. Who is that girl over there?

turns.speaker: Reza
turns.text: Oh, she is my sister. Her name is Dinda. We study here together.

challenge.scenario: Perkenalkan dirimu dan sebutkan 1 nama teman barumu di kelas menggunakan kata ganti 'I' dan 'He' atau 'She'.
challenge.exampleAnswer: Hello, I am Budi. This is Sarah, she is my friend.

questions.question: Pilihlah kata ganti subjek yang tepat: '___ is a software engineer.' (Merujuk pada Budi, seorang pria)
questions.explanation: Untuk subjek laki-laki tunggal, gunakan kata ganti 'He'.

questions.question: Manakah kalimat yang secara tata bahasa BENAR?
questions.explanation: Posisi subjek orang pertama tunggal selalu menggunakan 'I', bukan 'Me'.

questions.question: Kata ganti apa yang tepat untuk menggantikan 'My laptop'?
questions.explanation: Benda tunggal tak bernyawa digantikan dengan kata ganti 'It'.

modules.title: To Be (Am, Is, Are) & Sentence Core
modules.objective: Membedakan kalimat nominal (tanpa kata kerja aksi) dan menggunakan To Be secara otomatis tanpa kesalahan 'I am agree'.

content.summary: Dalam bahasa Inggris, SETIAP kalimat harus punya predikat. Jika kalimat tidak memiliki kata kerja aksi (seperti makan, minum, lari), maka 'To Be' (am, is, are) bertindak sebagai jembatan predikat.

rules.subject: I
rules.example: I am ready. / I am a teacher.

rules.subject: He / She / It
rules.example: He is happy. / She is at home. / It is cold.

rules.subject: You / We / They
rules.example: You are kind. / We are excited. / They are ready.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan Terbesar Penutur Indonesia: 'I AM AGREE'
commonTrap.explanation: Dalam bahasa Indonesia, kita berkata 'Saya setuju'. Orang sering mengartikan 'saya = I am' dan 'setuju = agree'. Ini SALAH TOTAL karena 'agree' sudah merupakan kata kerja aksi (Verb). Jangan tambahkan To Be di depan kata kerja bentuk dasar!
commonTrap.wrong: I am agree with you. / She is work here.
commonTrap.correct: I agree with you. / She works here. / I am happy (happy adalah kata sifat, jadi butuh To Be).

content.context: David menyapa rekannya Maya di kantor.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Hi Maya, how are you today?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Hi David! I am good, but I am a bit tired because of the morning traffic.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I understand. The roads are always crazy in the morning.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yes, they are! But I am ready for our meeting now.

drills.targetText: I am ready for the meeting.
drills.focus: Pelafalan 'I am' / 'I'm' tanpa tertukar kata kerja
drills.hint: Gunakan 'am' hanya untuk subjek 'I'.
Sambung 'are not' menjadi 'aren't' atau lafalkan jelas.

roleplay.context: Andi menanyakan kabar Budi yang tampak lelah di kantor.

turns.speaker: Andi
turns.text: Hi Budi, are you okay today?

turns.speaker: Budi
turns.text: I am a little tired, but I am okay. How about you?

turns.speaker: Andi
turns.text: I am very happy because tomorrow is holiday!

turns.speaker: Budi
turns.text: That is great news. We are ready for the weekend.

challenge.scenario: Jelaskan kondisimu saat ini (misal: senang, lelah, lapar) dan sebutkan kondisi teman atau kantormu menggunakan To Be.
challenge.exampleAnswer: I am happy today, and my office is very busy.

questions.question: Manakah kalimat bahasa Inggris yang BENAR ketika menyatakan 'Saya setuju dengan ide Anda'?
options: I am agree with your idea.
I am agreeing with your idea.
I was agree with your idea.
questions.explanation: 'Agree' adalah kata kerja aktif. Tidak boleh digabung dengan 'am'.

questions.question: Isilah titik-titik berikut: 'My parents ___ currently in Bali for vacation.'
questions.explanation: 'My parents' adalah subjek jamak (They), sehingga To Be yang digunakan adalah 'are'.

questions.question: Manakah pasangan subjek dan To Be yang KELIRU?
questions.explanation: 'We' adalah kata ganti jamak, harus berpasangan dengan 'are', bukan 'is'.

modules.title: To Be: Negative & Question Inversion
modules.objective: Mampu menyangkal dan membuat pertanyaan Yes/No menggunakan pembalikan To Be secara spontan.

sections.title: Pola Negasi dan Pertanyaan To Be

content.summary: Untuk negasi, tambahkan 'not' setelah To Be (is not = isn't, are not = aren't). Untuk pertanyaan, pindahkan To Be ke paling depan kalimat (Inversion).

rules.example: He is not late. / They aren't ready.
Are you ready? / Is she a manager?

rules.pattern: Yes, [Subj] + To Be / No, [Subj] + To Be not
rules.example: Yes, I am. / No, he isn't.

commonTrap.explanation: Dalam percakapan sopan, penutur asli jarang hanya menjawab 'No' karena terdengar dingin. Gunakan 'No, I'm not' atau 'No, he isn't'.
commonTrap.correct: Are you busy? -> No, I'm not. / Not really, what's up?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Excuse me, are you Mr. Anton from Surabaya?

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: No, I'm not. I am Anton from Malang.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Ah, my mistake! Is this your registration code?

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Yes, it is. Here is my ID card.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Perfect. You are all set. Welcome!

drills.hint: Naikkan nada suara di akhir kata 'teacher'.

drills.targetText: No, she is not a doctor.
drills.hint: Tegaskan kata 'not'.

roleplay.context: Di meja resepsionis seminar, petugas mengonfirmasi status peserta.

turns.speaker: Petugas
turns.text: Good morning! Are you a participant for the English seminar?

turns.speaker: Peserta
turns.text: Yes, I am. Here is my registration ticket.

turns.speaker: Petugas
turns.text: Thank you. Is that gentleman your colleague?

turns.speaker: Peserta
turns.text: No, he is not. He is a speaker for the next session.

challenge.scenario: Tanyakan kepada lawan bicaramu apakah dia seorang murid baru atau guru menggunakan kalimat tanya To Be.
challenge.exampleAnswer: Excuse me, are you a new student here?

questions.question: Bagaimana bentuk pertanyaan yang benar dari kalimat: 'She is your supervisor'?
questions.explanation: Pindahkan To Be 'is' ke awal kalimat untuk membentuk kalimat tanya nominal.

questions.question: Jika seseorang bertanya: 'Are they from Japan?', jawaban penolakan yang paling tepat adalah:
questions.explanation: Subjek 'they' dipasangkan dengan 'aren't' (are not).

modules.title: Pointing Objects: This, That, These, Those & Articles
modules.objective: Menunjuk benda tunggal dan jamak berdasarkan jarak, serta memakai artikel a/an/the dengan tepat.

content.summary: Gunakan This (dekat tunggal), That (jauh tunggal), These (dekat jamak), Those (jauh jamak). Artikel 'a' dipakai sebelum bunyi konsonan, 'an' sebelum bunyi vokal, dan 'the' untuk benda spesifik yang sudah diketahui kedua pihak.

rules.example: This is my laptop.
That building is very tall.
These keys are mine.
Those cars are expensive.
A university (bunyi /j/), An hour (bunyi /aʊər/)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Bukan Berdasarkan Huruf Tertulis, Tapi Bunyi Pengucapan!
commonTrap.explanation: 'Hour' dimulai dengan huruf 'H', tetapi pengucapannya bersuara vokal /aʊər/, maka wajib menggunakan 'AN HOUR', bukan 'a hour'. Sebaliknya 'University' berbunyi /juː/, maka menggunakan 'A UNIVERSITY'.
commonTrap.wrong: I will arrive in a hour.
commonTrap.correct: I will arrive in an hour.

content.context: Barista kafe menemukan barang di atas meja.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Excuse me, sir! Is this your wallet on the table?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Oh, let me see. Yes, that is mine! Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: What about these keys? Are these yours too?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: No, those keys aren't mine. That gentleman over there forgot them.

drills.hint: Keluarkan sedikit ujung lidah di antara gigi.
Pastikan ada bunyi getar /z/ di akhir 'those'.

roleplay.context: Rani dan Doni menemukan tas dan kacamata tertinggal di kafe.

turns.speaker: Rani
turns.text: Excuse me, is this your bag on the chair?

turns.speaker: Doni
turns.text: No, that is not mine. That bag is black, mine is blue.

turns.speaker: Rani
turns.text: What about these glasses on the table?

turns.speaker: Doni
turns.text: Yes, those are my glasses! Thank you so much.

challenge.scenario: Sebutkan 1 barang yang ada tepat di depanmu dengan 'This is' dan 1 barang yang berada di seberang ruangan dengan 'That is'.
challenge.exampleAnswer: This is my phone, and that is a whiteboard.

questions.question: Pilihlah artikel yang tepat: 'We need to wait for ___ hour before boarding.'
questions.explanation: Kata 'hour' diawali bunyi vokal /aʊər/, sehingga wajib menggunakan 'an'.

questions.question: Lengkapilah kalimat berikut untuk benda jamak di dekat pembicara: '___ shoes are very comfortable.'
questions.explanation: Benda jamak (shoes) yang posisinya dekat menggunakan 'These'.

modules.title: Possession: Have vs Has & Family Ties
modules.objective: Menyatakan kepemilikan benda dan relasi keluarga menggunakan Have/Has dan apostrof kepemilikan ('s).

content.summary: Gunakan 'have' untuk subjek I, You, We, They. Gunakan 'has' untuk subjek tunggal orang ketiga He, She, It.

rules.subject: I / You / We / They
rules.example: I have two sisters. / We have a meeting.

rules.subject: He / She / It
rules.example: She has a nice car. / The room has two windows.

rules.subject: Apostrophe 's
rules.example: Budi's phone (ponsel milik Budi), my father's car.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jangan Gunakan 'Have' untuk Orang Ketiga Tunggal
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak yang salah mengatakan 'My friend have a question'. Karena 'my friend' adalah tunggal (He/She), kata kerja yang benar adalah 'HAS'.
commonTrap.wrong: My boss have two cars. / She have a cold.
commonTrap.correct: My boss has two cars. / She has a cold.

content.context: Rani dan Kevin sedang mengobrol santai saat istirahat makan siang.

lines.speaker: Rani
lines.text: Do you have any pets at home, Kevin?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Yes, I have two cats. What about you?

lines.speaker: Rani
lines.text: I don't have pets, but my brother has a golden retriever dog. He loves animals.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: That's awesome! Golden retrievers are very friendly.

drills.focus: Bunyi /z/ pada 'has' untuk subjek orang ketiga
drills.hint: Gunakan 'has' untuk He/She, bukan 'have'.

drills.targetText: I have a laptop and a phone.
drills.hint: Sambung kata 'have a' menjadi 'hav-a'.

roleplay.context: Dina dan Kevin saling bercerita tentang hewan peliharaan dan keluarga.

turns.speaker: Dina
turns.text: Do you have any pets at home, Kevin?

turns.speaker: Kevin
turns.text: Yes, I have two cats. How about you?

turns.speaker: Dina
turns.text: I do not have pets, but my brother has a big dog.

turns.speaker: Kevin
turns.text: That is nice! He has a lovely companion.

challenge.scenario: Ceritakan 2 benda atau hal yang kamu miliki dengan 'I have' dan 1 hal yang dimiliki teman/keluargamu dengan 'He/She has'.
challenge.exampleAnswer: I have a motorcycle and a laptop. My sister has a red car.

questions.question: Pilihlah kata kerja yang tepat: 'Our teacher ___ a master degree from Australia.'
questions.explanation: 'Our teacher' adalah orang ketiga tunggal (He/She), sehingga memakai 'has'.

questions.question: Bagaimana menyatakan 'Mobil milik paman saya' secara alami?
questions.explanation: Gunakan apostrof 's (possessive noun) untuk kepemilikan orang.

modules.title: Asking About Possession: Do you have...?
modules.objective: Membuat kalimat tanya kepemilikan dengan Do/Does dan meresponsnya secara natural.

sections.title: Rumus Kalimat Tanya Do / Does Have

content.summary: Ketika membuat kalimat tanya kepemilikan di Simple Present, kata bantu 'Do' atau 'Does' diletakkan di depan. PENTING: kata kerja selalu kembali ke bentuk dasar 'have'.

rules.example: Do you have a pen? / Do they have time?
Does he have a car? / Does she have an extra key?
I don't have cash. / He doesn't have an umbrella.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jangan Dobel 'S': 'Does she has' adalah KELIRU
commonTrap.explanation: Karena 'Does' sudah menyerap akhiran orang ketiga tunggal, kata kerja setelahnya HARUS kembali ke 'HAVE', bukan 'HAS'.

content.context: Di luar gedung kantor hujan deras saat jam pulang kerja.

lines.speaker: Aldi
lines.text: Oh no, it is raining heavily. Do you have an umbrella, Lisa?

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: Yes, I do! I have a big umbrella. We can share.

lines.speaker: Aldi
lines.text: Thank you! What about Tommy? Does he have a ride home?

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: No, he doesn't have an umbrella, but he has a car in the basement.

drills.hint: Sambung 'have an' menjadi satu tarikan nafas.

drills.focus: Bentuk dasar 'have' setelah kata tanya 'Does he'
drills.hint: Jangan gunakan 'has' setelah 'Does'.

roleplay.context: Hujan tiba-tiba turun deras di luar perpustakaan.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Oh no, it is raining heavily outside. Do you have an umbrella?

turns.speaker: Rian
turns.text: No, I do not have one with me today. Does Tom have a car?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Yes, he has a car, but he is already in the parking area.

turns.speaker: Rian
turns.text: Let us wait here until the rain stops.

challenge.scenario: Tanyakan kepada rekan bicaramu apakah dia membawa pulpen cadangan atau uang kecil menggunakan 'Do you have...'.
challenge.exampleAnswer: Excuse me, do you have a pen I can borrow?

questions.question: Manakah bentuk pertanyaan kepemilikan yang BENAR?
options: Does your brother has a laptop?
Does your brother have a laptop?
Do your brother has a laptop?
Is your brother have a laptop?
questions.answer: Does your brother have a laptop?
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'Does' untuk subjek tunggal 'your brother' dan kata kerja kembali ke 'have'.

questions.question: Lengkapilah kalimat negasi berikut: 'I am sorry, but he ___ any spare change right now.'
questions.explanation: Bentuk negasi he/she/it adalah 'doesn't have'.

modules.title: Everyday Action Verbs: Present Simple 1
modules.objective: Menyusun kalimat aktivitas nyata sehari-hari menggunakan kata kerja aksi dasar.

content.summary: Present Simple digunakan untuk fakta umum, kebiasaan berulang, dan rutinitas harian.

rules.example: I wake up at 6 AM. / We work from home on Friday.
in the morning, in the afternoon, at night, on weekends

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jangan Tambahkan To Be di Depan Action Verb!
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering berkata 'I am work in a bank'. Ini salah karena 'work' adalah aksi. Cukup katakan 'I work in a bank'.
commonTrap.wrong: I am live in Surabaya. / They are study English.
commonTrap.correct: I live in Surabaya. / They study English.

sections.title: Kata Kerja Rutinitas Pagi Hingga Malam

content.context: Dua rekan kerja mengobrol saat tiba di kantor.

lines.speaker: Hendra
lines.text: You look very fresh today! What time do you wake up?

lines.speaker: Dewi
lines.text: I wake up at 5:30 AM every day. I exercise for thirty minutes and have a healthy breakfast.

lines.speaker: Hendra
lines.text: Wow, impressive! I usually wake up at 7:00 AM and rush to the office.

lines.speaker: Dewi
lines.text: Starting early really changes your energy level throughout the day!

drills.focus: Kata kerja tindakan 'drink' dan ritme kalimat
drills.hint: Ucapkan 'drink' dengan jelas tanpa imbuhan.

drills.targetText: We work from home on Friday.
drills.hint: Gunakan 'on' untuk nama hari.

roleplay.context: Rudi dan Fajar saling bertukar cerita tentang rutinitas pagi sebelum kantor.

turns.speaker: Rudi
turns.text: What time do you usually wake up every day?

turns.speaker: Fajar
turns.text: I wake up at five in the morning, then I drink tea.

turns.speaker: Rudi
turns.text: Do you exercise before you go to work?

turns.speaker: Fajar
turns.text: Yes, I run for twenty minutes in the park.

challenge.scenario: Sebutkan 2 aktivitas yang selalu kamu lakukan di pagi hari menggunakan kalimat Present Simple.
challenge.exampleAnswer: I wake up at six and I eat breakfast with my family.

questions.question: Manakah kalimat yang tepat untuk menyatakan 'Saya sarapan pada pukul 7 pagi'?
options: I am have breakfast at 7 AM.
I am eat breakfast at 7 AM.
questions.explanation: Gunakan kata kerja aksi bentuk dasar tanpa menyisipkan 'am'.

questions.question: Frasa alami penutur asli untuk 'bepergian menggunakan kereta ke kantor' adalah:
questions.explanation: 'Commute by train' adalah collocation alami dalam bahasa Inggris.

modules.title: The S/ES Rule for Third Person
modules.objective: Menerapkan aturan penambahan akhiran -s, -es, dan -ies pada kata kerja orang ketiga tunggal (He/She/It).

content.summary: Ketika subjek adalah He, She, It atau nama orang tunggal, kata kerja dalam Present Simple WAJIB ditambah akhiran -s/-es.

rules.example: walk -> walks, work -> works, speak -> speaks
watch -> watches, wash -> washes, go -> goes, do -> does
study -> studies, fly -> flies
play -> plays, buy -> buys

commonTrap.trapTitle: Lupa Menambahkan 'S' Karena di Bahasa Indonesia Tidak Ada
commonTrap.explanation: Dalam bahasa Indonesia, kita berkata 'Dia bekerja' sama dengan 'Saya bekerja'. Di bahasa Inggris, wajib ada pembeda antara 'I work' dan 'She works'.
commonTrap.wrong: My sister work in a hospital. / He go to gym every day.
commonTrap.correct: My sister works in a hospital. / He goes to the gym every day.

content.context: Dua teman berbincang tentang kesibukan keluarga.

lines.speaker: Fajar
lines.text: What does your wife do, Dimas?

lines.speaker: Dimas
lines.text: She teaches chemistry at an international high school.

lines.speaker: Fajar
lines.text: That's fantastic! Does she enjoy it?

lines.speaker: Dimas
lines.text: Yes, she loves it. She designs interactive experiments for her students every week.

drills.hint: Ucapkan 'watch-iz' dengan dua suku kata.
Jangan lupa bunyi 's' di akhir kata kerja orang ketiga.

roleplay.context: Tari menceritakan pekerjaan kakaknya kepada Dimas.

turns.speaker: Tari
turns.text: My sister works in a hospital in Surabaya.

turns.speaker: Dimas
turns.text: Really? What does she do there?

turns.speaker: Tari
turns.text: She treats patients. She loves her job very much.

turns.speaker: Dimas
turns.text: That is wonderful. She helps many people every day.

challenge.scenario: Ceritakan 1 pekerjaan atau rutinitas yang dilakukan oleh teman atau keluargamu menggunakan kata kerja berakhiran -s/-es.
challenge.exampleAnswer: My father works in a bank, and he drinks tea every afternoon.

questions.question: Pilihlah bentuk kata kerja yang tepat: 'My brother ___ computer science at university.'
questions.explanation: Kata 'study' berakhiran konsonan + y, berubah menjadi 'studies'.

questions.question: Bentuk orang ketiga tunggal dari kata kerja 'watch' adalah:
questions.explanation: Kata kerja berakhiran -ch ditambah -es ('watches').

modules.title: Habits & Frequency: Always to Never
modules.objective: Menjelaskan seberapa sering melakukan sesuatu dengan posisi kata keterangan frekuensi yang tepat.

content.summary: Adverbs of frequency diletakkan SEBELUM kata kerja utama, tetapi SETELAH To Be.

scale.example: I always drink water first thing in the morning.
They often eat out on Saturdays.

commonTrap.explanation: Jangan menaruh kata frekuensi di akhir kalimat seperti pola bahasa Indonesia 'Saya minum kopi selalu'. Letakkan sebelum kata kerja aksi.
commonTrap.wrong: I drink always coffee. / I late always.
commonTrap.correct: I always drink coffee. / I am always late (setelah To Be).

sections.title: Percakapan: Gaya Hidup & Kebiasaan Akhir Pekan

content.context: Dua sahabat bertukar cerita tentang akhir pekan.

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.text: Do you often travel on weekends, Tom?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Not really. I usually stay at home and cook. I rarely go outside on Sundays.

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.text: Really? I never stay at home on weekends! I always meet my friends or ride my bicycle.

drills.focus: Posisi 'always' tepat sebelum kata kerja utama
drills.hint: Letakkan 'always' sebelum 'wake', bukan di akhir kalimat.
'Rarely' berarti sangat jarang.

roleplay.context: Sita dan Bayu membicarakan kebiasaan akhir pekan mereka.

turns.speaker: Sita
turns.text: Do you often cook on the weekend, Bayu?

turns.speaker: Bayu
turns.text: I rarely cook at home. I usually eat out with friends.

turns.speaker: Sita
turns.text: I always cook on Sunday because I love making soup.

challenge.scenario: Sebutkan 1 hal yang selalu kamu lakukan dan 1 hal yang jarang kamu lakukan menggunakan kata 'always' dan 'rarely'.
challenge.exampleAnswer: I always read books at night, and I rarely drink coffee.

questions.question: Susunlah urutan kata yang benar: [late / is / she / never]
questions.explanation: Adverb of frequency diletakkan SETELAH To Be ('is never late').

questions.question: Manakah kalimat yang secara posisi adverb BENAR?
options: I drink green tea sometimes always.
Sometimes I am drink green tea.
questions.explanation: Kata 'sometimes' diletakkan tepat sebelum kata kerja aksi 'drink'.

modules.title: WH-Questions: Seeking Facts & Information
modules.objective: Membuat pertanyaan informatif menggunakan Who, What, Where, When dengan kata bantu Do/Does/To Be yang tepat.

content.summary: WH-Question membutuhkan kata bantu (Do/Does atau To Be) sebelum subjek. Rumus baku: WH + Auxiliary + Subject + Verb / Complement.

rules.example: What do you do? (Apa profesimu?)
Where do you live? / Where is the station?
When does the train leave?
Who is your manager?

commonTrap.explanation: Dalam bahasa Indonesia, kita cukup berkata 'Di mana kamu tinggal?'. Dalam bahasa Inggris, kalimat tanya WAJIB memiliki kata bantu 'do' atau 'does'.
commonTrap.wrong: Where you live? / What you want?
commonTrap.correct: Where do you live? / What do you want?

sections.title: Percakapan: Berkenalan Lebih Dekat dengan Rekan Proyek

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Where do you live in Jakarta, Maya?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I live in South Jakarta, near Tebet station. What about you?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: I live in Tangerang, so I take the commuter line every morning.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: What time do you usually leave home?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: At 6:30 AM to avoid the heavy rush hour.

drills.hint: Turunkan nada suara pada kata 'live'.
Rangkai secara lancar tanpa jeda per kata.

roleplay.context: Dua rekan tim proyek saling mengenal latar belakang satu sama lain.

turns.speaker: Nadia
turns.text: Where do you live, Rico?

turns.speaker: Rico
turns.text: I live in South Jakarta. Where are you from?

turns.speaker: Nadia

turns.speaker: Rico
turns.text: What do you do in this project?

turns.speaker: Nadia
turns.text: I design the user interface.

challenge.scenario: Ajukan 2 pertanyaan menggunakan kata tanya 'Where' dan 'What' kepada rekan barumu.
challenge.exampleAnswer: Where do you work, and what is your favorite food?

questions.question: Pilihlah bentuk pertanyaan yang benar untuk menanyakan tempat tinggal seseorang:
questions.explanation: Subjek 'you' membutuhkan kata bantu 'do' di depan subjek.

questions.question: Kalimat tanya 'What do you do?' paling tepat berarti:
options: Apa yang sedang kamu kerjakan sekarang?
questions.explanation: 'What do you do?' adalah idiom formal standar untuk menanyakan pekerjaan seseorang.

modules.title: Quantity & State: How, How much, How many
modules.objective: Menanyakan harga, kuantitas benda terhitung/tak terhitung, dan keadaan secara akurat.

sections.title: Perbedaan How Much vs How Many

content.summary: How many digunakan untuk benda yang bisa dihitung (countable nouns, selalu bentuk jamak). How much digunakan untuk benda tak dapat dihitung (uncountable nouns) dan menanyakan HARGA.

rules.question: How many + Plural Noun
rules.example: How many languages do you speak? / How many rooms are there?

rules.question: How much + Uncountable Noun
rules.example: How much water do you drink a day? / How much sugar do you want?

rules.question: How much is / are...?
rules.example: How much is this coffee? / How much are those shoes?

rules.question: How often...?
rules.example: How often do you go to the gym?

commonTrap.explanation: Walaupun uang bisa kita hitung jumlah lembarnya, kata 'money' dalam bahasa Inggris berstatus Uncountable. Jadi tanyakan 'How much money', bukan 'How many money'.
commonTrap.wrong: How many money do you need?
commonTrap.correct: How much money do you need?

items.meaning: Struk / Nota belanja (huruf P tidak dibaca)

content.context: Pelanggan memesan kopi di konter barista.

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: Good morning! What can I get for you today?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Hi! Can I have an iced Americano, please?

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: Sure. How much sugar would you like with that?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: No sugar for me, thank you. How much is it?

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: That is thirty-five thousand rupiah. Would you like a receipt?

drills.targetText: How much is this iced coffee?
drills.hint: Gunakan 'How much is' untuk benda tunggal.

drills.targetText: How many cups do you want?
drills.hint: Pastikan kata benda berakhiran 's' (cups).

roleplay.context: Memesan minuman di kafe yang ramai.

turns.speaker: Barista
turns.text: Welcome to Kopi Kita! What can I get for you?

turns.speaker: Pelanggan
turns.text: Hello! How much is a cup of hot cappuccino?

turns.speaker: Barista
turns.text: It is thirty-five thousand rupiah. How many cups would you like?

turns.speaker: Pelanggan
turns.text: I would like two cups, please. Less sugar for both.

turns.speaker: Barista
turns.text: Sure thing! That will be seventy thousand rupiah.

challenge.scenario: Tanyakan harga 1 botol air mineral dan pesan 2 botol kepada pelayan.
challenge.exampleAnswer: Excuse me, how much is this water? I want two bottles, please.

questions.question: Isilah pertanyaan berikut: '___ cups of coffee do you drink per day?'
questions.explanation: 'Cups' adalah benda jamak yang dapat dihitung (countable), gunakan 'How many'.

questions.question: Pilihlah kalimat yang benar untuk menanyakan harga sepasang sepatu:
questions.explanation: 'Shoes' adalah jamak, jadi gunakan 'How much are'.

modules.title: Full Context Simulation: Meeting a New Friend
modules.objective: Mengintegrasikan seluruh materi M01 s.d. M11 dalam skenario percakapan sosial nyata tanpa terputus.

content.summary: Percakapan yang baik memiliki 3 bagian: Answer + Extra Detail + Return Question (A-E-R). Jangan hanya menjawab satu kata!

rules.example: Yes, I do.
I work at a tech company in Jakarta as a designer.
How about you? What do you do?

commonTrap.explanation: Jika seseorang bertanya 'Do you like sports?' dan Anda cuma menjawab 'Yes', lawan bicara akan merasa canggung. Berikan sedikit detail ekstra.
commonTrap.correct: Yes, I do! I love swimming and I often swim on Saturday mornings. Do you like sports too?

items.collocation: By the way, where is your office?
Ah, I see. That makes sense.

sections.title: Percakapan Utuh: Mengobrol Saat Menunggu Acara

content.context: Budi dan Claire bertemu di ruang tunggu sebuah seminar internasional.

lines.speaker: Budi
lines.text: Excuse me, is this seat available?

lines.speaker: Claire
lines.text: Yes, it is! Please, go ahead and sit down.

lines.speaker: Budi
lines.text: Thank you. By the way, I am Budi. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Claire
lines.text: Nice to meet you too, Budi. I am Claire. Are you here for the digital marketing workshop?

lines.speaker: Budi
lines.text: Yes, I am! I work at a creative agency, so this workshop is very helpful for me. How about you?

lines.speaker: Claire
lines.text: I have an online clothing store. I usually handle everything myself, so I want to learn more.

lines.speaker: Budi
lines.text: That's very impressive! How many people are on your team right now?

lines.speaker: Claire
lines.text: Right now, I only have two assistants, but they are very hardworking.

drills.targetText: It is nice talking to you.
drills.hint: Lafalkan dengan intonasi ramah dan bersahabat.

drills.targetText: What do you usually do in your free time?
drills.hint: Lafalkan lancar tanpa terputus di tengah.

roleplay.context: Dua peserta mengobrol santai sambil menunggu sesi workshop dimulai.

turns.speaker: Clara
turns.text: Hello, is anyone sitting here?

turns.speaker: Gilang
turns.text: No, please sit down. My name is Gilang, by the way.

turns.speaker: Clara
turns.text: Nice to meet you, Gilang. I am Clara. Are you from Jakarta?

turns.speaker: Gilang
turns.text: Yes, I am. I work as an accountant here. How about you?

turns.speaker: Clara
turns.text: I am a graphic designer from Yogyakarta.

turns.speaker: Gilang
turns.text: That sounds very interesting! Do you enjoy your job?

turns.speaker: Clara
turns.text: Yes, I love it. Oh, the workshop is starting now!

turns.speaker: Gilang
turns.text: Great. It is nice talking to you, Clara.

challenge.scenario: Lakukan perkenalan diri lengkap: sebutkan namamu, pekerjaanmu, kota asalmu, dan 1 kebiasaan yang sering kamu lakukan.
challenge.exampleAnswer: Hello, my name is Budi. I am an engineer from Jakarta, and I usually exercise in the morning.

questions.question: Jika lawan bicara bertanya 'Where do you work?', respon mana yang paling sopan dan membuat obrolan tetap hidup?
options: I work at a bank in Jakarta as an analyst. What about you?
questions.answer: I work at a bank in Jakarta as an analyst. What about you?
questions.explanation: Pola Answer + Extra Detail + Return Question membuat obrolan ramah dan mengalir.

questions.question: Frasa apa yang tepat digunakan untuk mengganti topik pembicaraan secara santai?
options: On the other hand I am
questions.explanation: 'By the way' adalah transisi alami untuk memperkenalkan topik baru.

modules.title: Level A1.1 Comprehensive Graduation Assessment
modules.objective: Ujian evaluasi akhir komprehensif menguji seluruh kompetensi M01 s.d. M12. Raih skor minimal 75% untuk kelulusan.

content.summary: Ujian ini terdiri dari 10 soal komprehensif yang menguji kata ganti, To Be, Have/Has, Present Simple, dan kalimat tanya. Kerjakan dengan teliti.

rules.detail: Membuka modul level berikutnya secara permanen di profil akun Anda.

drills.targetText: I am ready for the graduation test.
drills.hint: Ucapkan dengan artikulasi tegas dan jelas.

drills.targetText: We speak English with confidence every day.
drills.hint: Perhatikan jeda alami setelah kata 'English'.

roleplay.context: Wawancara singkat kelulusan level A1.1 bersama Instruktur.

turns.speaker: Instruktur
turns.text: Congratulations on reaching the final module! Are you ready?

turns.speaker: Siswa
turns.text: Yes, I am ready. I have studied all the materials thoroughly.

turns.speaker: Instruktur
turns.text: Wonderful. Please tell me about yourself and your daily routine.

turns.speaker: Siswa
turns.text: I live in Jakarta, I work in an office, and I practice English every day.

challenge.scenario: Sampaikan pidato singkat kelulusan A1: ceritakan siapa dirimu, apa yang kamu miliki, dan kebiasaan belajarmu dalam bahasa Inggris.
challenge.exampleAnswer: Hello! I am a student. I have a dream to speak English fluently, and I practice every single day.

questions.question: Pilihlah kalimat yang secara tata bahasa 100% BENAR:
options: I am agree with your opinion.
questions.explanation: 'Agree' adalah kata kerja aktif, tidak memerlukan To Be 'am'.

questions.question: Lengkapilah kalimat berikut: 'My sister ___ two cats, but she ___ have a dog.'
questions.explanation: Orang ketiga tunggal afirmatif memakai 'has', dan negasi memakai 'doesn't have'.

questions.question: Pilihlah bentuk kalimat tanya kepemilikan yang tepat:
options: Does your father has a car?
Does your father have a car?
Do your father has a car?
Is your father have a car?
questions.answer: Does your father have a car?
questions.explanation: Gunakan kata bantu 'Does' dan kata kerja kembali ke 'have'.

questions.question: Pilihlah artikel yang benar: 'He is ___ honest person and works at ___ university.'
questions.explanation: 'Honest' berbunyi vokal /ɒn.ɪst/ (an honest), sedangkan 'university' berbunyi konsonan /juː/ (a university).

questions.question: Susunlah kalimat dengan posisi adverb of frequency yang benar:
questions.explanation: Adverb of frequency diletakkan SETELAH To Be 'is'.

questions.question: Lengkapilah kalimat berikut: 'My father ___ to work by commuter train every morning.'
questions.explanation: Subjek 'My father' (He) membutuhkan akhiran -es pada kata kerja 'go'.

questions.question: Pertanyaan yang tepat untuk menanyakan harga secangkir kopi adalah:
questions.explanation: Untuk menanyakan harga benda tunggal, gunakan 'How much is'.

questions.question: Manakah bentuk pertanyaan tempat tinggal yang baku?
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat tanya Simple Present: WH + do + subject + verb.

questions.question: Menunjuk beberapa buku yang terletak jauh di seberang ruangan:
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'Those' untuk benda jamak yang letaknya jauh.

questions.question: Respon terbaik yang menjaga percakapan tetap mengalir saat seseorang bertanya 'Do you live in Jakarta?':
options: Yes, I do. I live in South Jakarta. Do you live here too?
I am living in Jakarta yes.
questions.answer: Yes, I do. I live in South Jakarta. Do you live here too?
questions.explanation: Pola Answer + Extra Detail + Return Question adalah teknik komunikasi terbaik.
